lines: A package root carries code, so the package is imported as a whole:
markdown-it: 151,203 B in 52 modules on the kanso-main page, of which its root lib/index.mjs is 5,599 B.
Importing the single module that is used instead of the package root lets the bundler drop the rest of the barrel.
All 4 pages load the same 1 file: 215,938 B raw, 79,456 B gzip, 62.5 % of the smallest page (kanso-public, 345,346 B).
Inside: @vue/runtime-core 53,143 B, axios 46,237 B, vite-plugin-node-polyfills 29,450 B, dompurify 29,270 B, @vue/reactivity 17,709 B.
vite-plugin-node-polyfills, 29,450 B on the kanso-main page: Node APIs polyfilled into a browser bundle.
No module is delivered twice inside one page.
No bundler chunk in js is left without something that loads it.
